Hi Bethany / Samir —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and the ask to lock our next session: we recommend a 2-hour hands-on integration lab where we walk platform + infra teams through:

- End-to-end ingestion (S3 -> Redwood)
- SSO & scoped test credentials (verification)
- Sample throughput/latency checks with your sample corpus
- KV cache / prefix-caching demo relevant to your flow

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Mar 23, 10:00–12:00
- Thu Mar 25, 14:00–16:00

Can you confirm which works better and who from Security / Procurement will be on the call? If possible, please share a prework contact for procurement (name + email). I attached a short prework spreadsheet to capture required accounts and SSO details — filling that out before the lab will save 20–30 minutes on the day.

Also, two quick asks:
1) Are there any specific compliance checks you want us to run during the lab?
2) Will you want a separate 30-min follow-up for legal/procurement to review estimated spend and reserved capacity options?

Thanks — I’ll hold both windows tentatively until I hear back.
